result.reasoning: This commit introduced the code that renames a species (via spe.setName()) when it derives the name from the primary thermo library, but it never regenerated the Chemkin-formatted NASA thermo polynomials (which embed the species name). The fix commit adds the missing spe.generateNASAThermoData() call right after this same setName() call, directly addressing the omission introduced by 7339cc176cc7.
